item.title: COMING Saturday August 29 | Keller & The Keels w/sg Tanasi — Mon Aug 24 — French Broad River Brewery
item.description:
Saturday, August 29 • 7 PM – 11 PM | From $45.70 Event Details and Tickets Musical Mad Scientist Keller Williams brings his Appalachian Psychedelic Bluegrass project, Keller & the Keels, to the stage on Saturday, August 29 with special guest Tanasi. Joining him are award-winning flatpicker Larry Keel and his rock-solid, in-the-pocket bass-playing wife, Jenny Keel. The trio—formed in 2004—has recorded three albums together (Grass, Thief, and Speed), and with only a handful of shows each year, every performance turns into a joyful, high-energy acoustic picking party. As Keller puts it, “We vowed from the beginning that we wouldn’t do it often so that when we did, it would be special—and it is.” 2026 marks the 20th anniversary of Grass, Keller & the Keels’ first album together. After two decades, Grass finally gets its first-ever vinyl pressing—available on site and ready to roll.

item.title: Raising My Children While Healing the Child in Me — Mon Aug 24, 2:00 PM
item.description:
Asheville Community Mom's Group **RSVPing on Meetup doesn’t reserve your spot for this session!**
To join, please sign up through our site here: https://www.totem.org/spaces/session/vqs549hwe/
All sessions are free, and signing up on the site helps us create a smoother experience for everyone. Feel free to message me with any questions or concerns!
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
Parenting can bring us face-to-face with parts of our own childhood we thought we had moved past.
The way our children need comfort, protection, patience, play, reassurance, and love can remind us of what we received, what we missed, and what we are still learning to give ourselves.
This Session is about the complicated work of raising our children while healing the younger parts of ourselves. Together, we will explore the ways motherhood can reopen old wounds, offer new understanding, and give us opportunities to create something different for both our children and ourselves

item.title: Yellowstone Falls Rock Scramble — Sat Aug 29, 9:30 AM
item.description: The Asheville Hiking Group On this hike we will actually get to Yellowstone Falls which many have not seen, even though it is just below Graveyard Fields and 2nd Falls, since it is best to climb up the creek to get there. We begin the hike at the Looking Glass Overlook. From the Mountains to Sea Trail, we cross the creek at Skinny Dip Falls. Then we scramble up the rocks and boulders in Yellowstone Prong to Yellowstone Falls. We take a short break for lunch, then will climb up stream right on a steep but doable path through the mountain laurels. We continue up Yellowstone Prong to 2nd Falls. We will end up at the Graveyard Fields parking lot. For those with the time we will continue down the top portioin of the Seniard Ridge Trail and back to the parking lot. If you have limited time you can leave your car at Graveyard Fields and shuttle back down to the Looking Glass Overlook, which is only about 5 minutes by car. It adds half an hour to the hike to complete the loop down to the cars.

Asheville Tech Events ## Details
Join us for our monthly project/co-working day! Bring your own project for co-working or jump in on an existing project. We can use all different kinds of support, from emailing to data entry to coding.
**Location:** Hi Wire Brewing - Biltmore Village / Guajiro Cuban food truck 2A Huntsman Pl, Asheville, NC 28803
**What to expect:** (Feel free to drop in when you can and leave when you need to.)
* *11am*: Arrival and introductions. Say hi and catch up with your Code with Asheville crew. * *11:15-11:30am*: Folks chat through what they hope to accomplish for the day, ask for help, and divide into small groups for certain projects. This is a great place to get plugged in if you're looking for a project to work on. * *11:30am*: We get to work! All writers and all experience levels are welcome and don’t worry, no one will see what you've written. This session is about getting your writing done and meeting other writers in your area.
Please arrive a few minutes early to say hello to everyone, grab a drink, and get your writing tools ready. Once everyone’s arrived, I will lead quick introductions and then set the timer for our quiet and focused writing session.

## About Ted Riskin
Ted is interested in anything that can get him out of his head, and music and movement do a pretty good job of that. He hopes to offer music that facilitates an inner journey and invitations that create a shift. While he likes modern electronic music, he can’t create a mix without including lots of natural instruments and voices. Due to a short attention span, he mixes in lots of different musical genres. You can hear some of his mixes on [https://www.mixcloud.com/tarisk/](https://www.mixcloud.com/tarisk/) \~\~\~

item.title: TRADITIONAL IRISH MUSIC SESSION — Sun Oct 11, 3:30 PM
item.description:
Jack's long-running Traditional Irish Music Session is the perfect way to enjoy the Celtic-influenced sounds of talented musicians from all over WNC & further afield!
Stop in to enjoy the music — going strong from 3:30pm until close — along with a pint or and Irish coffee and the best public house fare in town!
Sláinte, y'all!
Source: Jack of the Wood, Where Y'at AVL Music

item.title: OLD-TIME JAM — Wed Oct 14, 5:00 PM
item.description:
The roots of Appalachian old-time music stretch far across the Atlantic and we're proud to honor and showcase that legacy at Jack of the Wood Pub with our long-running Old-Time Jam sessions — every Wednesday starting at 5pm! Recently recommended by Rolling Stone for "those looking for an organic, participatory [music] experience" in Asheville, the Old-Time Jam is one of several weekly traditional jam sessions hosted at JACK.
Our cozy Celtic pub is the perfect spot downtown to take in some of the region's finest traditional acoustic musicians playing "in the round" while you enjoy a pint or two and the best pub fare in town!
Source: Jack of the Wood, Where Y'at AVL Music

item.title: BLUEGRASS JAM — Thu Oct 15, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Don't miss your chance to check out some of the best pickers from all over WNC at our celebrated Bluegrass Jam curated by the multi-talented Drew Matulich — every Thursday starting at 7:00 pm!
It's always a show-stopping night of extraordinary musicianship — and it's only at Jack of the Wood Pub!
Open jam follows at 9:30 pm.
Source: Jack of the Wood, Where Y'at AVL Music

item.title: Cavalry Episcopal Church Food Pantry — Sat Nov 21, 8:00 AM — Cavalry Episcopal Church
item.description:
* Food is provided according to household size and selected by the clients themselves, with the help of a volunteer shopping assistant. * Clients use shopping carts, and volunteers escort them to their vehicles and help load their items. * In addition to packaged foods, fresh produce, eggs, milk, bread, and frozen meat is available. * Provide roughly 3 1/2 meals worth of food per person per week. * On select Saturdays, the UNC Eshelman School of Pharmacy and Walgreens offer blood pressure checks and nutrition counseling.
Source: Henderson County Food Distributions
